::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 28th [after 1887]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Resource Center, University of Texas at Austin
:::

Dear Madam

Perhaps the book is out of print – My own private copy of ‘[What to Read](cmy_books/cmybook_196.qmd)’ is one in sheets, the extras having been given away – so that [RTS](organizations/other_35.qmd) may have been taken out later. I have not the Half Hours still, I must have given them away or lent them, and so I cannot refer to them for the publisher[^1]

Yours truly,
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: It is not at all clear what book is referred to here, and CMY herself does not seem to have published a book of this name.  However, a book did appear called *Sunny Half-Hours: pleasant tales at pleasant times. By Aunt Charlotte* (London: Dean 1876).
